title: The copy API, typed correctly
prompt:
1. `static <T> void copy(List<? extends T> src, List<? super T> dst)` — append every
element of src to the end of dst. Must NOT disturb existing dst content.
2. `static void swap(List<?> list, int i, int j)` — swap two elements. Because `?`
cannot be written to, implement via a private generic capture helper
`static <E> void swapHelper(List<E> list, int i, int j)` and call it.
Both must compile with exactly these signatures (wildcards in the public API).

tests.name: copy appends without disturbing
swap via wildcard capture
tests.hint: The unknown becomes a named E inside the helper.
